description: Test suite for chat model reference helper functions in a TypeScript project, using Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: buildChatModelOption
methods.description: Builds provider-qualified option value and label for a chat model catalog entry.

methods.name: createChatModelOverride
methods.description: Creates a chat model override object from a raw value.

methods.name: formatChatModelDisplay
methods.description: Formats a chat model reference for display, including provider qualification if applicable.

methods.name: normalizeChatModelOverrideValue
methods.description: Normalizes a chat model override value based on the catalog, resolving ambiguous or raw values to catalog entries when possible.

methods.name: resolveChatModelOverride
methods.description: Resolves a chat model override to its catalog source, providing value and source info.

methods.name: resolveServerChatModelValue
methods.description: Resolves server session data to qualified chat model values.

methods.name: resolvePreferredServerChatModel
methods.description: Chooses the preferred chat model based on server info and catalog matching, with fallback logic.
